title: Support that continues after delivery.
body: Final warranty and service terms will be published before Founder payments are accepted. KAIZURO intends to provide clear registration, assessment and support pathways for every numbered production rod.

items.title: Registered ownership
items.body: Each Founder rod is linked to its numbered certificate and digital rod passport.

items.title: Clear warranty terms
items.body: Coverage, exclusions, assessment requirements and claim steps will be stated before payment.

items.title: Component support
items.body: Serviceable components and replacement pathways will be documented as production specifications are locked.

items.title: Direct KAIZURO contact
items.body: Owners can contact KAIZURO directly for product registration, support and delivery questions.
